FAQ

Common Questions

Quick answers based on the business information you provided.

What are the haircut prices?

Haircut without washing is 300 ETB. Haircut plus hair wash and face wash is 350 ETB.

Can I choose any haircut style?

Yes. The shop provides any kind of men's haircut style. You can also add notes or show a reference photo.

Can I request beard adjustment?

Yes. Select beard adjustment when booking. A separate beard price was not provided, so the shop should confirm it.

Does the wash include conditioner?

Yes. The hair wash service includes shampoo and conditioner.

What time is the shop open?

7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Where is the shop?

Gerji, Mebrathaile, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The Location tab includes Google Maps and a direct Directions button.
